initiatives.title: Checkout and payments
initiatives.description: Build the cart, checkout and card payments so customers can buy coffee, subscriptions and gift cards in one flow.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Customers can complete a purchase in under a minute, and every payment reconciles in Stripe.
initiatives.internalNote: Stripe account is in Dana's name; she needs to add Tom as a developer before we can test live payments.

initiatives.title: Launch the new shop
initiatives.description: Switch the domain to the new shop, redirect old product URLs and watch the first week of orders closely.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Online orders in the first month match or beat the old shop.

initiatives.description: A half-day workshop with Dana's team to agree what the new shop must do on day one.
initiatives.outcome: Agreed 14 must-have features, with subscriptions and wholesale pricing at the top of the list.

initiatives.title: Design sign-off
initiatives.description: Designs for the home page, product pages, cart and checkout, approved by Dana.
initiatives.outcome: Signed off a day early, on 4 September.

initiatives.title: Product catalogue import
initiatives.description: Move every product, photo and variant from the old shop into the new catalogue.
initiatives.outcome: All 212 products imported with photos and variants. We spot-checked 30 against the old shop.

ideas.title: Import script for products and variants

updates.author: tom
updates.text: All 212 products imported with photos and variants. Spot-checked 30 against the old shop.

initiatives.title: EHR integration
initiatives.description: Connect the intake forms to the clinic's records system so patient details arrive without retyping.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: New patient records appear in the EHR within a minute of a form being submitted.
initiatives.externalDependency: Sandbox access from the EHR vendor
initiatives.internalNote: CareStack still hasn't issued sandbox API keys. Escalate to Sam if nothing arrives by Thursday 8 Oct.

updates.text: Asked CareStack support for sandbox API keys a second time; ticket #48213.

initiatives.title: Accessibility audit
initiatives.description: Check every form against WCAG 2.2 AA with screen readers and keyboard-only use, and fix what we find.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: No AA failures on any patient-facing page.

initiatives.title: Staff training
initiatives.description: Two short sessions for front-desk staff on reviewing submitted forms and helping patients who get stuck.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Every front-desk staff member has processed a test submission.

initiatives.title: Go-live
initiatives.description: Turn on online intake for new patients and retire the paper forms.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Half of new patients complete intake online in the first month.

initiatives.title: Requirements sign-off
initiatives.description: Agree which forms move online first and what data the clinic needs from each.
initiatives.outcome: Six forms prioritised; insurance details deferred to phase two.

initiatives.title: Form designs approved
initiatives.description: Designs for all six intake forms and the patient dashboard, reviewed with clinic staff.
initiatives.outcome: Approved on 26 August, four days after the target, after one extra review round with nurses.

initiatives.targetOutcomes: One chosen direction, with notes we can act on.

initiatives.title: Brand guidelines
initiatives.description: Develop the chosen logo into a full identity: colour, type, imagery and a short guidelines document.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Lumen's team can brief a printer or designer from the guidelines alone.

initiatives.title: Final asset handoff
initiatives.description: Deliver logo files, templates and the guidelines in a shared folder, with a walkthrough call.
initiatives.targetOutcomes: Every file Lumen needs is in one place and named consistently.

initiatives.title: Brand audit
